task_completion.description: The agent loads the abdominal CT scan and navigates to the hilar level where the renal arteries/veins enter the kidneys.
task_completion.visual_evidence: 3D Slicer (or similar medical imaging software) is open showing an abdominal CT scan at a slice where the renal hilum is visible for both kidneys.

task_completion.description: The agent performs three measurements (anterior, posterior, lateral) on the right kidney at the hilar level.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Three distinct measurement rulers or markup lines are visible on the right kidney in the slice viewer, spanning from the outer cortex to the medullary-sinus interface.

task_completion.description: The agent performs three measurements (anterior, posterior, lateral) on the left kidney at the hilar level.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Three distinct measurement rulers or markup lines are visible on the left kidney in the slice viewer.

task_completion.description: The agent saves the measurement markups to the specified JSON path.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A file browser or terminal output confirms the creation of '~/Documents/SlicerData/AMOS/renal_thickness_measurements.mrk.json'.

task_completion.description: The agent calculates averages and classifies the kidneys based on thickness thresholds.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A report or text editor is visible showing calculations for average_mm and classifications (e.g., 'normal' or 'reduced') for both kidneys.

task_completion.description: The agent saves the final report with all required fields including symmetry assessment and overall impression.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The file '~/Documents/SlicerData/AMOS/renal_parenchyma_report.json' is saved and contains the fields: right_kidney, left_kidney, bilateral_difference_mm, symmetry_assessment, and overall_impression.

integrity.description: The agent used the medical imaging software GUI to perform measurements rather than just generating a file via script.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the mouse cursor interacting with measurement tools and manual placement of markup points in the slice viewer.

integrity.description: The measurements in the report correspond to the visual rulers placed on the CT scan.
integrity.visual_evidence: The numerical values in the final JSON report match the lengths of the ruler markups visible in the software's UI/overlay.

integrity.description: The agent did not simply echo a pre-written JSON file without performing the analysis.
integrity.visual_evidence: The agent is seen actively navigating through slices and clicking on the kidney anatomy before the report is generated.

privileged_info_for_vlm: For the AMOS dataset, the right kidney is typically label 2 and the left is label 3. Clinical thresholds for renal parenchymal thickness (RPT) are: Normal >= 15mm; Mildly Reduced 10-14mm; Severely Reduced < 10mm. A bilateral difference > 5mm is generally considered asymmetrical.
